evidence.reason: The code stores only the first request ID per item at line 235 (`!byItem.has(item)`). Because line 244 compares the single stored ID against `query.predecessor`, a second request bound to the same item is not recognized as explicit, and line 261 then emits the row under the first request ID. This is a concrete correctness defect for reused/joined review items, not a request to add new requirements.
